summary:
Jetlog is a self-hosted flight tracker, seeded as user dana with 223 flights. I saved all 5 views, and each one matched when the harness replayed it. The app signed me in automatically through the local auth proxy, so I didn't need sign-in steps.
1. dashboard (/): summary stat tiles, a world map of visited airports and routes, and recent flights.
2. flights-list (/flights): the sortable table of all flights.
3. flight-detail (/flights?id=120): one flight (OAK→SAN), with its route header, departure and arrival airport cards, a route map and seat/class details.
4. statistics (/statistics): stat tiles and charts (flights per month, cumulative distance, top airports and airlines).
5. new-flight (/new): the entry form after typing ASA509 and pressing Fetch. The local stub filled in SAN→SEA on Alaska Airlines. The flight is never saved, so the replay changes no data.

I didn't capture Settings (import/export, users, maintenance jobs) because there were only 5 view slots and the other screens show the app's main interfaces better.
